title: At the Café
text:
Anna is in a café. She opens the menu and reads it. The menu has soup, salad and pizza. Anna wants soup today.

The waiter comes to the table with a smile. Anna orders soup and a glass of water. The soup costs five dollars. Anna pays and says thank you.

options: Soup and a glass of water

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about the service in the café?
options: She feels happy with the service
She is angry with the waiter
She is very tired and sleepy

questions.text: Where does the waiter probably work?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks that you can order
a person who brings food and drinks to customers in a restaurant
asks for food or drink to be brought
a hot liquid food made from vegetables or meat

paragraph_translations: Anna siedzi w kawiarni. Otwiera menu i je czyta. Menu ma zupę, sałatkę i pizzę. Anna dziś chce zupę.
Kelner podchodzi do stolika z uśmiechem. Anna zamawia zupę i szklankę wody. Zupa kosztuje pięć dolarów. Anna płaci i mówi dziękuję.
